newsitem.title: USA: Williams says natgas pipelines outpacing 96.
newsitem.headline: Williams says natgas pipelines outpacing 96.

text.p: Williams Cos Inc said Friday that its natural gas pipelines were performing ahead of last year's record pace.

The company reported second quarter primary earnings of $0.65 per share compared with earnings per share of $0.48 in last year's second quarter. Williams said it recognized a gain of about $44.5 million in the second quarter from a transaction involving its customer-premise equipment business.
The company reported second quarter operating profit of $5.3 million in its Merchant Services business, down from operating profit of $15.9 million in the year ago period.
Merchant Services, part of the the Williams Energy Group, provides energy commodity trading, risk management, retail sales and service and energy capital.

While its natural gas physical trading volumes were five percent higher than a year ago, operating profit declined primarily due to substantially lower margins on natural gas and liquid petroleum trading activities, and the expense of its expanding its business growth platforms, the company said.
